excluded_under_broadened_rubric_note: Rescreened all Brazil/LATAM-tagged listings across quality, regulatory affairs, and medical affairs (not just clinical ops/trial management) per the broadened rubric. Only additional candidates found were ClinChoice's Brazil-based Safety Officer, Drug Safety Associate, Medical Reviewer, and Regulatory Affairs Analyst roles — all titled 'Consultant' (contract) and/or junior-level, which score below 60 because they don't offer equal-or-better long-term pay/career growth vs. the candidate's current Portfolio Manager role. Also searched Brazilian-market employers directly on Gupy (Synvia, IDOR, Eurofarma, Rennova): excluded lab-technician/nursing/finance/QC/pre-clinical-R&D postings as out of scope, and excluded mid-level ('Pleno') and junior/broad-band postings (CRA all-levels, Monitor Sênior individual-contributor site-monitoring, Analista de Assuntos Regulatórios, Analista de Farmacovigilância Sr, Analista de Desenvolvimento Clínico Pleno) that score below 60 once compensation and seniority step-down from a portfolio-management role are weighed honestly. Rede D'Or's main 1,607-job board, Hospital Santa Lucinda, PUCRS, and Cristália/Hypera Pharma were checked and ruled out (wrong function or no current openings) in favor of IDOR (Rede D'Or's dedicated research institute).
